neighbours.label: the first fragment of a verb the tokenizer splits, starting with a prefix (' resc', 'res' in disrespect, ' disse', Russian ' ос', ' рем'), as opposed to whole-token verbs
fire: The board voted to rescind the policy last week.
The new law rescinded the earlier ban on fishing.
Teenagers who disrespect their elders get detention.
The agency tried to disseminate false reports.
His critics disrespected him in public.
quiet: The board voted to cancel the policy last week.
The new law removed the earlier ban on fishing.
Teenagers who insult their elders get detention.
The agency tried to publish false reports.
His critics mocked him in public.

notes: The + pole fires on the bare prefixes (' re', ' ré', ' sup', ' bl'), and its output suppresses ' re', ' reg'. So this pole may be the 'prefix plus more letters' side of a 'bare prefix' distinction. Not all fragments fire (' refurb' 0.09, ' rew' 0.16).
